scientific_integrity: An exact geometric/topological theorem is proved for coordinate-parallel box Minkowski offsets of cubical skeleta. Numeric and finite cubical-chain checks support but do not substitute for the general argument. All statements explicitly include width ties and critical scales.
scientific_limitations: The construction assumes axis-parallel boxes and full standard cube skeleta; it does not cover rotated boxes, Euclidean ball offsets, arbitrary polyhedral complexes, or guarantee historical uniqueness. No independent external validation has occurred.
title: Anisotropic box convexification of cubical skeleta: exact persistence and void-loss exponents
